title: DRY-RUN FIX — standalone scripts: add readRealPosts helpers to daily-digest/morning-brief/watchdog/generate-daily-report/weekly-report
changes: scripts/daily-digest.ts: added readRealPostsDD(), fixed getQueueStats() and getPostingStreak() to use it
scripts/morning-brief.ts: added readRealPostsMB(), fixed gate ETA pace calculation to use it
scripts/scs001/watchdog.ts: added readRealPostsWD(), fixed checkGateDeadline() to use it
scripts/generate-daily-report.ts: added readRealPostsDR(), fixed getPipelineOutput() and getGateProgress() to use it
scripts/weekly-report.ts: added readRealPostsWR(), fixed weekly post/view stats to use it
root_cause: Standalone cron scripts (not using shared.ts) had raw readLines(manual-posts.jsonl) calls that included dry-run entries, inflating gate/streak/queue metrics in automated reports
fix: Added readRealPosts helper (unique name per file to avoid conflicts) after readLines in each script
